name: Orkas
summary: Metered chat, web search, speech, image and video APIs for external applications, alongside a local-first desktop AI team.
description: Hosted, paid API for chat (OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions), web search, speech, images and video. Requests use an Orkas API key and credits. The API is separate from the open-source, local-first macOS/Windows desktop app, where a Commander coordinates specialist agents. MIT licensing covers only the public desktop app source; the hosted API is a proprietary service. Terms: https://orkas.ai/views/legal/terms.html · Privacy: https://orkas.ai/views/legal/privacy.html

agent_access.notes: Send the Orkas API key as Authorization: Bearer. Chat uses the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://orkas.ai/v1; search, speech and media endpoints have their own documented request fields. The API does not expose desktop Commander orchestration. MIT license applies to the desktop app only, not the hosted API.
